title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: our monolithic CI workflows were growing slow and brittle: large matrices, long lint/test runs blocking release jobs, and inefficient cache usage causing repeated installs. This PR splits the previously combined 'lint-test-release' workflow into three focused workflows and introduces targeted cache keys and controlled parallelism for install/cache steps to reduce contention and improve cache hit rates.

Summary of changes: 
- Split .github/workflows/ci.yaml into ci.lint.yaml, ci.test.yaml, ci.release.yaml.
- Standardize job names and make lint jobs shallow (no heavy integration steps).
- Introduce per-job cache key strategy: OS + node-version + pnpm-lockhash + deps-shard for large packages.
- Add controlled parallelism settings for cache restore/save to avoid thundering-herd on runners.
- Consolidate common reusable workflow templates under .github/workflows/templates/ for lint/test/release steps.
- Update repo README CI section and contributing docs with new developer guidance and migration steps.

Checklist:
- [x] Split workflows and added templates
- [x] Verified cache keys locally and on CI with multiple matrix entries
- [x] Fixed lint warnings introduced by workflow refactor
- [x] Updated docs and quickstart notes

Migration notes: developers using local workflow dispatch should switch to the new workflow names; existing scheduled release automation will continue to be triggered but now runs a lighter pre-release check and a separate release job to reduce RTO when external integrations fail.

Performance note: initial metrics across repo CI show ~30% average wall-clock reduction on test job latency for small PRs and reduced median cold-cache package install time by ~45% in the most active packages.

Related: ENG-1482 (CI performance), ENG-1501 (release automation hygiene).

diff_snippet:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yaml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.lint.yaml
@@
- name: Lint and tests
- jobs:
-   build:
-     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-     strategy: matrix: node-version: [18,20]
+ name: Lint
+ on: [pull_request, workflow_dispatch]
+ jobs:
+   lint:
+     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+     steps:
+       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+       - name: Restore deps cache
+         uses: actions/cache@v4

merge_details: Merged by squash on 2026-02-21 by Priya Nair. Merge title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism. Includes signed-off-by line and changelog entry.
release_notes: Split CI workflows: lint, test, and release separated for faster feedback loops; improved cache keys and parallelism settings to reduce cold installs and runner contention. No behavioral changes to product.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: new cache key/shard strategy could cause transient cache misses and slightly longer CI runs initially. Mitigation: fallback to monolithic cache key, monitored cache hit rate, rollback plan to revert workflow filenames to previous single workflow if systemic regressions detected.
notes_for_oncall: If release automation fails post-merge, check ci.release.yaml logs and the trace upload step; workflow includes a manual rollback document at infra/infra-helpers/ci-setup.md.
